technical.summary: CDW shows solid bullish technicals with multiple moving average alignments and MACD crossover confirmation, but overbought conditions on RSI-21 and Williams %R combined with weak ADX trend strength and neutral sector momentum limit entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: CDW shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 6 days present elevated volatility risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: mixed — senior member sales ($100k-$250k x2) offset by junior member purchase ($1k-$15k)
sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal; mixed congressional activity (senior Republican sales vs. Democratic purchase) 147-153 days old, neutral market sentiment, and unavailable news data provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX 179 crisis regime, FOMC just passed) combined with critical earnings binary event in 6 days create extreme risk environment for CDW.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + MACD crossover up + DC20 new high provide technical confirmation of bullish momentum with price near support (187.50) offering defined risk entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings binary in 6 days combined with VIX crisis regime (179), inverted yield curve, RSI/Williams overbought conditions, weak ADX trend confirmation, and zero fundamental/insider conviction create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows three white soldiers and MACD crossover confirmation, but this is insufficient to justify entry given critical earnings binary in 6 days and VIX crisis regime (179) creating extreme volatility risk.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 6 days combined with inverted yield curve and VIX crisis regime creates binary event risk that negates technical setup; overbought RSI/Williams conditions lack ADX trend confirmation.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already 45 positions in Information Technology sector; adding CDW increases concentration risk in high-volatility sector during macro headwinds.
